rationale: The original entry thesis relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA and stabilizing above $10.22, both of which have failed as price broke below the $10.15 9-EMA. The most recent 1-minute candle closed at its low of $10.12 on a heavy volume spike (50k shares vs 3k-14k on prior bars), showing aggressive selling pressure just two cents above our $10.10 stop. While shorting is unattractive because the stock remains in a broader uptrend well above the $9.68 session VWAP, exiting the long now avoids likely slippage through the $10.10 level.
